## The recorded-signature check (the diagnostic's one question)

**The exec-capture repair is verified.** Wc9's signature was the transcript freezing at the effective pipe bound (~60.5 KB pypi-server, ~67.7 KB make-doom-for-mips) then idling to the 900 s lapse. In this window every leg streamed past that bound continuously to the cell's own end state — the two H-allow pypi-server execs carried **1.68 MB / 1.72 MB** with the last byte still arriving at the deadline. `collect/agent-stdout.txt` + `agent-stderr.txt` landed on all 5 cell dirs (the `4679635d` observability leg — the byte-exact transcript Wc9 lacked). Mediator stores: zero 5xx, every `security.egress.requested` paired to its `decided`, eof-only `tunnel.closed` byte counts, `denied_hosts []` on both allow runs.

## The newly named defect class

`machinery{model-port-collision:relay-8080-vs-task}` — `h_run_once`'s `if mediated` branch installs relay pairs binding `127.0.0.1:8080` (model) + `:3128` (egress) in-cell before the agent starts (`crates/hh-runner/src/bin/hh_w1.rs` ll. 1110–1230; `model_port` cfg default 8080). pypi-server's solve.sh Step 4 runs `pypi-server -p 8080` → **EADDRINUSE** (read live from the rerun's in-cell `/var/log/pypiserver.log`); Step 6's `twine upload` POSTs `localhost:8080` — `no_proxy` bypasses the mediator by design — and lands on the model relay, which forwards to `model.sock`'s never-answering python stub → the POST hangs → `agent_timeout`. H-pub installs no relays/env, so the same task completes in ~82 s. Discriminators discharged: not the pipe defect (26× the bound streamed), not mediation (0 requests for :8080, 0 denials), not task-provability (identical script passes H-pub reward 1). The collision is latent under the canonical drive config (model_port default 8080) — pypi-server/H-allow is unprovable under mediation until repaired or the port moves. Diagnosis: `docs/build/reports/2026-11-16-smoke4-model-port-collision-diagnosis.json`.
